name: Nōgata (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Nōgata city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of vertical bars.
history: Municipal flag of Nōgata, a city in Fukuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 September 1973; the emblem dates from 26 July 1932.

features.role: Nōgata city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of vertical bars
